courtyard: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: courtyard composition reference for original horror game VESPERWOUND, titled 'ASH QUAY'. Landscape cinematic environment concept, elevated three-quarter game camera roughly 50 degrees pitch. Compact 16 by16 metre mortuary-industrial courtyard at blue-grey dusk: wet worn cobblestone with drainage grates and restrained puddles, black iron pipes hugging weathered stone walls, oxidized brass valves, steps and arched doorways. Central original pressure engine: vertical riveted iron boiler in a circular stone cradle, caged pale mint glowing breathing chamber, brass pressure gauges, three exhaust chimneys, tendon-like cables, restrained porcelain ornaments. Not steampunk carnival, no huge gears. Foreground left a realistic adult female engineer with dark waxed split coat, leather harness, compact dark hair bun, brass amber lantern and an iron hooked tool. Clear readable paths and asymmetrical authored composition. Warm amber player focal point, cold rim light on stone and metal, limited lamps, thin low drifting mist, damp tactile PBR surfaces, dramatic shadows, high quality game environment art. One large composition plus two small detail panels for machinery and wet paving; no interface or HUD, no copying existing games, no text other than 'ASH QUAY' and 'VESPERWOUND'. Grounded original industrial horror.
